title: MangoTPA
description: A simple tpa and tpahere plugin.
body:
A lightweight and intuitive teleportation plugin for Minecraft that brings essential player-to-player teleportation to your server. Simplify navigation and enhance community play

    /tpa <player> – Request to teleport to another player.

    /tpahere <player> – Request another player to teleport to your location.

    /tpaccept - accepts another players teleport request

    /tpdeny - denies another players teleport request
